name: key-generator
title: SSH Key Manager
description: Generate, audit, and manage SSH keys and SSH config entries.
author: kaushalrajpuwar

preferences.name: customSshKeygenPath
preferences.title: Custom SSH-Keygen Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to Homebrew's ssh-keygen. Required for FIDO hardware keys on a custom Homebrew prefix.

commands.name: list-keys
commands.title: List SSH Keys
commands.description: Browse local SSH keys, copy details, rename files, or delete keys.

commands.name: generate-key
commands.title: Generate SSH Key
commands.description: Create a new SSH key and copy the generated public key.

commands.name: ssh-config
commands.title: Manage SSH Config
commands.description: Create, edit, and connect to hosts from ~/.ssh/config.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal Emulator
preferences.description: Choose which terminal app to use for Connect.

preferences.name: customTerminalCommand
preferences.title: Custom Terminal Command
preferences.description: Used only when Terminal Emulator is Custom Command. Must include {{command}} placeholder (required). Example: open -a "Alacritty" --args -e zsh -lc "{{command}}"

commands.name: audit-keys
commands.title: Audit SSH Keys
commands.description: Find and fix common SSH key security issues.
